svg.text: V, S, M (a ball of bat guano and sulfur)
A bright streak flashes from you to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a
low roar into a fiery explosion. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that
point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking
Fire damage on a failed save or half as
much damage on a successful one.
Flammable objects in the area that aren’t being worn or carried start burning.
for each spell slot level above 3.
